title: E-Commerce API Documentation
description: A comprehensive, interactive RESTful API designed to power scalable e-commerce applications. It provides standardized endpoints for managing product catalogs, user authentication, shopping carts, order processing, and payment integrations with structured JSON responses and error handling.

title: Course Booking API Documentation
description: The Course Booking API allows developers to integrate course scheduling, searching, booking, and payment processing directly into their applications. This RESTful API is designed to manage the full lifecycle of a course, from initial setup to user enrollment.

title: Course Booking APP
description: A course booking app allows students, professionals, or hobbyists to discover, enroll in, and schedule educational classes. These platforms handle everything from self-paced online courses and live virtual bootcamps to in-person workshops (such as fitness classes, driving lessons, or cooking seminars).

title: E-commerce APP
description: An E-commerce app is a mobile or web software application designed to facilitate online buying and selling. It acts as a digital storefront where customers can browse product catalogs, view detailed specifications, select items, and complete secure purchases using integrated payment systems.

title: Airline Booking System Mockup
description: An airline booking system mockup design is a visual blueprint or UI/UX prototype that illustrates how users interact with a flight reservation platform. It maps out the visual hierarchy, user interface elements, and layout components across desktop or mobile screens before any actual coding takes place.

title: Airline Booking System Prototype
description: An airline booking system prototype design is an interactive, high-fidelity visual model of a flight reservation platform. It bridges the gap between static mockups and a functional web or mobile app, allowing stakeholders and portfolio reviewers to experience the actual user journey, click through navigation paths, and evaluate the usability of the interface.

title: Short Course Capstone
description: A short course capstone project is a culminating academic or professional assignment designed to let learners apply the comprehensive skills, tools, and concepts they have learned throughout a focused, intensive program. Unlike standard homework or quizzes, a capstone mirrors real-world challenges, requiring students to plan, execute, and present a complete project from scratch.
